_note: V1 hand annotation of Morrison et al. 2019 (ASME V&V 40), by Claude. Written before running any router against it. Its transcribed per-factor goals already live in tests/fixtures/extract/ground_truth/morrison-cou{1,2}.json.
_source: Morrison et al., ASAIO J 2019, hemolysis in centrifugal blood pumps
_coverage_limit: Only 4 of 13 pack factors are annotated. Morrison states its per-factor goals in Tables 3-4 as 'Selected Goal: Activity (x)' with the rationale inside the table, not in body prose -- the same shape as Bologna. Its value to this corpus is not factor routing.
_what_it_is_for: Morrison is the model-risk document. It states BOTH inputs of the V&V 40 risk derivation, in prose, for two different contexts of use: 'Model Influence: the influence is low because the data to support the safety assessment are based on in vitro test data' and 'Decision Consequence: if the pump causes high levels of hemolysis while the patient is in the surgical suite, then the pump can be replaced'. Across the synthetic corpus, model influence is stated in 0% of documents. This is the K8 test case.

_d1_recovery: Factors added after D1. The first annotation excluded them as 'no annotatable evidence found'; an independent annotator located evidence for 10 of the 12 excluded pairs across three documents. The exclusions were the annotator's failure to find, not the property's absence -- which means every routing figure measured before this was measured on an easier subset.
